raw_content: {"internal_thinking":"Charlie hit my Brick 6. That really hurts my road expansion plans. He's clearly trying to stay on Alice's good side after our trade. I need to play off the 'betrayal' angle lightly without being too aggressive, keeping my 'charming' persona. Alice is gloating, but Charlie is the one who actually made the move.","note_to_self":"Charlie moved the robber to Hex 5 (Brick 6), blocking my main brick source. I thought we were building a beautiful friendship with those gardens. Alice, I hope you're happy now that the roads have stopped!"}
